decisions.selected: Measure publication of the workflow's requested daily constraint-solving discussion.
alternatives: Measure discussion quality or educational usefulness.
decisions.rationale: The adoption-time workflow explicitly instructs the agent to publish a daily Discussion and defines its title prefix and category.

decisions.selected: One UTC calendar-date publication opportunity per run.
decisions.rationale: The schedule is daily, while the workflow permits dispatches and does not provide a stable problem identifier before execution.

decisions.selected: Use case.date when present, otherwise the UTC date from run.createdAt; preserve duplicate date keys and rerun subjects.
alternatives: Assign by a generated problem name
Assign only when an event payload is present.
decisions.rationale: The date is available for every run and supports deterministic historical reconstruction when case and event are null.

decisions.selected: Same-repository Discussions API records matching Announcements, the frozen title prefix, assigned UTC date, and cutoff.
alternatives: Discussion body length or output volume.
decisions.rationale: A created Discussion is the direct repository artifact requested by the workflow; evals, traces, and volume do not establish publication.

decisions.selected: Seven days after run creation, with cutoff capped at maturity.
decisions.rationale: The workflow's publication is expected daily and the configured discussion lifecycle is seven days; a fixed seven-day horizon makes late evidence stable.

decisions.selected: Binary direct attainment: 1 when at least one qualifying Discussion exists, otherwise 0; unavailable evidence is null.
alternatives: Discussion count as the primary metric
A quality score based on body sections.
decisions.rationale: Publication is the single directly observable operational outcome; count is retained only as a diagnostic and quality is not a frozen repository outcome.
The first available workflow commit establishes intent but no comparable pre-adoption workflow opportunity or frozen contract exists; activity and evals are not valid substitutes.

decisions.selected: Report qualifying discussion count separately with latest aggregation.
alternatives: Combine count with publication into an index
Report agent output and trace counts.
decisions.rationale: Count provides context without changing the single authoritative attainment value and avoids treating volume as operational value.

uncertainties.description: The Discussions API may be unavailable or may omit historical records at evaluation time.
A qualifying Discussion can be deleted or its category changed after collection.
The observation does not establish that the workflow caused a Discussion matching the contract.
